fields.label: Plastic data, adhesion system, cleaning/abrasive stages, static control or QA references

fields.name: b7_t3_q1
fields.label: 1. Why do plastics often need different preparation from metal panels?

fields.name: b7_t3_q2
fields.label: 2. What is the purpose of adhesion promoter?

fields.name: b7_t3_q3
fields.label: 3. (a) How can poor cleaning cause paint failure on a bumper? (b) Why might static control be important on plastic components?

fields.name: b7_t3_q4
fields.label: 4. How can flexibility requirements affect product choice?

fields.name: b7_t3_q5
fields.label: 5. (a) What checks show that the bumper is ready for coating? (b) What evidence should support the selected plastic refinish system?

fields.name: b7_t3_obs_1
fields.label: Identify plastic repair/refinish considerations before preparation begins.

fields.name: b7_t3_obs_2
fields.label: Clean, abrade and prepare a plastic surface using a controlled process.

fields.name: b7_t3_obs_3
fields.label: Select appropriate adhesion promoter, primer or flexible additive where applicable.

fields.name: b7_t3_obs_4
fields.label: Recognise contamination and static risks linked to plastic refinishing.

fields.name: b7_t3_obs_5
fields.label: Record process evidence and QA checks clearly.

fields.name: b7_t4_special_tools
fields.label: Blend plan, spray-out evidence, colour data, defect guide or QA references

fields.name: b7_t4_q1
fields.label: 1. Why is blend planning important for modern paint finishes?

fields.name: b7_t4_q2
fields.label: 2. How can metallic or mica orientation affect colour match?

fields.name: b7_t4_q3
fields.label: 3. (a) What additional control is needed for a three-stage pearl finish? (b) Why should spray-out evidence be kept with the job record?

fields.name: b7_t4_q4
fields.label: 4. What defects are common when blend edges are poorly managed?

fields.name: b7_t4_q5
fields.label: 5. (a) How should a painter decide whether rectification is needed? (b) What evidence would show an advanced blend was planned correctly?

fields.name: b7_t4_obs_1
fields.label: Plan a blend process using colour evidence and panel layout.

fields.name: b7_t4_obs_2
fields.label: Explain control of metallic, mica, pearl or three-stage finishes.

fields.name: b7_t4_obs_3
fields.label: Use spray-out or comparison evidence to justify colour decisions.

fields.name: b7_t4_obs_4
fields.label: Identify likely defects and rectification options for advanced finishes.

fields.name: b7_t4_obs_5
fields.label: Record the process, QA checks and evidence for assessor review.

fields.label: OEM data, sensor information, EV/hybrid guidance, heat limits or referral references

fields.name: b8_t3_q1
fields.label: 1. Why must EV and hybrid systems be considered before paint-shop work?

fields.name: b8_t3_q2
fields.label: 2. How could booth bake or infrared curing create risk on some vehicles?

fields.name: b8_t3_q3
fields.label: 3. (a) Why must ADAS sensor areas be identified before refinishing? (b) When should work stop and be referred to a qualified person?

fields.name: b8_t3_q4
fields.label: 4. How can masking or paint build affect sensors or calibration?

fields.label: Recognise visible signs of EV, hybrid, ADAS and alternative-fuel systems.

fields.name: b8_t3_obs_2
fields.label: Identify paint-shop operations that could affect sensors, batteries or safety systems.

fields.name: b8_t3_obs_3
fields.label: Apply safe awareness-level controls and stop-work/referral decisions.

fields.name: b8_t3_obs_4
fields.label: Record restrictions, warnings, heat/cure considerations and communication notes.

fields.name: b8_t3_obs_5
fields.label: Explain limitations of competence clearly and professionally.

fields.name: b8_t4_q1
fields.label: 1. Why do matte finishes require special care during refinish work?

fields.name: b8_t4_q2
fields.label: 2. What contamination risks are linked to aluminium preparation?

fields.name: b8_t4_q3
fields.label: 3. (a) How can carbon fibre or GRP change preparation decisions? (b) Why should curing method be matched to the surface and product?

fields.name: b8_t4_q4
fields.label: 4. How can UV or targeted curing reduce energy use?

fields.name: b8_t4_q5
fields.label: 5. (a) What work should be referred rather than attempted without guidance? (b) What evidence would show a sustainable process decision?

fields.name: b8_t4_obs_1
fields.label: Recognise specialist surfaces such as aluminium, GRP, carbon fibre and matte finishes.

fields.name: b8_t4_obs_2
fields.label: Identify contamination, sanding, product and finish limitations before work.

fields.name: b8_t4_obs_3
fields.label: Use technical information to select safe preparation and curing controls.

fields.name: b8_t4_obs_4
fields.label: Consider waste, energy use and sustainable curing choices.

fields.name: b8_t4_obs_5
fields.label: Record the process decision and evidence clearly.
